sections.title: Control-plane architecture
sections.content: Acceptance uses immutable, identity-bound artifacts: freeze candidate and baseline, create changed-set and complete Consumer Closure, run real required checks, choose typed mode and route, then import matching evidence before Acceptance alone publishes acceptance-passed. Evidence producers remain non-authorizing.

sections.title: Authority and routing
sections.content: Lifecycle ownership is VDD for draft/plan-ready, maintainer for implementation-authorized, Quick Dev adapters for implementation-complete, and Acceptance for acceptance-passed. Deterministic failures launch no reviewers. Focused/full routes require Bootstrap; triggers upgrade to full or manual pause; supervised deterministic-only requires a current maintainer decision.

sections.title: Review isolation and recovery
sections.content: Bootstrap Complete Review retains three isolated roles. Each child uses an immutable Segment Descriptor, segment-only frozen snapshot, and inherited access proof. Process events govern liveness, validated Effective Progress, lease reconciliation, bounded retry, and non-authorizing recovery; heartbeats and prose are not progress or authority.

sections.title: Projection, verification, and rollout
sections.content: Selected authority is delivered whole within budget or by controller-owned hash-bound Range Projection. Required checks bind real execution and exact reuse inputs. M0-M2 delivery includes recovery invariants, Acceptance strategy, semantic corpus, 8-13 scale regression, cost metrics, and no false authorization.
